## About Marcus

Marcus Kim is CIO of RetailFlow, joining 2 years ago from a technology consulting firm. Emma brought him in specifically to drive technology transformation and build AI capabilities.

Marcus is passionate about AI and frustrated by legacy systems. He believes RetailFlow needs to move faster on digital transformation to remain competitive.

## Technology Focus

- AI adoption and implementation
- System modernization
- Data and analytics capabilities
- Digital transformation speed
